decision: Drop of 30 grid positions for the next Race in which the driver participates.
fact: The following Power Unit elements have been used: 5th Engine (ICE) 5th Turbocharger (TC) 5th Exhaust Set (EXH)
offence: Breaches of Articles B8.2.2 (read in conjunction with B8.2.3) of the FIA F1 Regulations.
penalty: Drop of 30 grid positions for the next Race in which the driver participates.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with Article B8.2.8 of the FIA F1 Regulations. Subject to Car 41 being classified in the results of Qualifying, Car 41 will be allocated a grid position in the Race in accordance with Article B2.5.4b.iv of the FIA F1 Regulations.
